why: Groups neighbourhoods into service profiles. k = 2 scores highest on silhouette but only recovers deprived and not deprived, which the service already knows, so the search is restricted to a range that is operationally useful and the trade-off is reported rather than buried.

Finds neighbourhoods that are unusual for Colchester, which is not the same as deprived in absolute terms. Contamination is fixed rather than tuned: with 105 points and no ground truth there is nothing honest to tune it against, so the ranked scores are published alongside the binary flag.
